independent_argument: An adjacent inverted pair a>b beginning at t contributes 2t+2a+b to total completion time. Swapping gives 2t+2b+a, saving a−b; later jobs are unchanged. Repeated exchanges remove all inversions. This assumes all jobs available on one machine with equal weights, no setup times or dependencies.
limitations: Exact finite checks supplement the stated argument; not a claim about audience understanding.
